website.policy: Approved official-site appearance is retained. No redesign, new theme, layout replacement, or new generated visual asset is part of this release.

admin.policy: The v10 shell, typography, CSS system, responsive overrides, and character-control visual language remain the accepted baseline; production integration changes are behavioral/data wiring only.

website: Preserved approved homepage/hero/menu assets and permanent play URL behavior.
Wired register, verification request/confirm, login, current session, logout, password-reset request/confirm, and authenticated password change to current WS13 routes.
Kept #dashboard fail-closed behind GET /api/account/v1/session/current; changing the hash alone cannot open authenticated content.

For newly created or replaced credentials, frontend enforces a conservative KO1298-compatible 10-12 printable-ASCII byte envelope without trim, truncation, normalization, transliteration, or hidden transformation.
Verification/reset UI no longer claims mail was definitely sent and never exposes demo/action tokens; it reports only an accepted request and provides the real token-entry path.
Dashboard character cards render only characters returned by the current authenticated WS13 session.
Cash/payment, 2FA, support tickets, nation/race change, and name change remain explicitly unavailable when no verified backend contract exists.
admin: Preserved v10 CSS/visual asset set while replacing demo/runtime fallback behavior with same-origin /api/admin production calls.

Added a fail-closed session gate: authorized panel content remains hidden until /api/admin/session resolves; unauthenticated users receive the real login form and API failure shows an unavailable state without demo data.
Actor identity, roles, and permission-driven controls come from WS08 session data; unconditional ROOT OWNER/sample-account presentation was removed.
Dashboard overview, players, character detail, inventory, Inn, transactions, sanctions, item search/duplicates/history/actions, and audit are wired to WS08 endpoints.
GM commands display the exact queue request/status/trace returned by WS08. A queued request is not represented as executed.
Restart, maintenance, shutdown and other operations without a verified WS08 contract are disabled rather than simulated.
Removed production references to previewbridge1298.js and admin/preview-link.js from admin/index.html.

credential_envelope_ws03.required_shared_boundary: 10-12 bytes for website credentials that must authenticate through KO1298

checks.static_production_invariants: PASS: no 128-character new-password controls; canonical current WS13 password routes present; no production localhost/ngrok/trycloudflare/preview-link references in modified production entrypoints; no demo-mode/sample osevinc/fake 247/1842/3991/fake audit row in active admin entrypoint/runtime.
checks.baseline_asset_identity: PASS_FOR_UNCHANGED_VISUAL_ASSETS: homepage index/hero/v14 CSS+JS and account-v15.css retained; admin v10 CSS, character-control.css and responsive-overrides.css retained.

blockers.detail: Frontend now prevents creation/replacement of incompatible credentials, but the authoritative WS13 server still needs to enforce the shared KO1298-compatible byte envelope.
Verification/reset delivery must be configured and operationally observable before production mail delivery can be claimed.
Current WS08 intentionally refuses fake production persistence and cannot start production mode until the real repository adapter is wired.
Frontend can truthfully show queue acceptance/PENDING_BRIDGE now, but cannot show authoritative SUCCEEDED/FAILED execution without a terminal status read contract.

blockers.owner: this frontend task before merge when a usable browser target is available; then WS10 on real domains
blockers.detail: Desktop/mobile source and immutable baseline assets are checked, but rendered comparison was not completed because the available headless Chromium environment failed to complete even a minimal smoke. No rendered visual PASS is claimed.
No DNS/deployment changes were made here. HTTPS domain behavior remains unvalidated until WS09 deployment and WS10 real-domain acceptance.
